description: Embed a YouTube video, a Spotify track, album, playlist, podcast or artist, an Instagram post or reel, or a TikTok video, so it plays on the page. TikTok needs the full tiktok.com/@name/video/… link, not a short vm.tiktok.com one.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

url.description: A YouTube, Spotify, Instagram or TikTok link.

name: add_embed
title: Embed a video or song
